CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_grpart_info (_grId uuid, _lang TEXT, _partPosition INTEGER) RETURNS TABLE ( featurePartId uuid, partDate jsonb, partSeasonalPeriod TEXT, partInformation TEXT, partType TEXT ) AS $$
BEGIN
RETURN QUERY (select distinct grPart.id as grPartId, to_jsonb(json_agg(distinct jsonb_build_object('position', grPartDate.position, 'date_start', to_char(grPartDate.date_start, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'date_end', to_char(grPartDate.date_end, 'DD/MM/YYYY')))) as grPartDate, string_agg(distinct concat(grPartSeasonPeriod.day_start, '/', grPartSeasonPeriod.month_start, '-', grPartSeasonPeriod.day_end, '/', grPartSeasonPeriod.month_end), ',') as grPartSeasonalPeriod,
case _lang WHEN 'fr' THEN grPart.information WHEN 'en' THEN CASE WHEN (grPart.international_information is not null) THEN grPart.international_information ELSE grPart.information END END as partInformation,
case _lang when 'fr' THEN string_agg(distinct grPartTypeTranslation.translation, ', ') when 'en' THEN string_agg(distinct grPartTypeTranslation.international_translation, ', ') END as partType
from georegulation_part as grPart left join georegulation as gr on gr.id = grPart.georegulation_id left join georegulation_part_type as grPartType on grPartType.part_id = grPart.id left join georegulation_part_type_i18n as grPartTypeTranslation on grPartTypeTranslation.enum_name=grPartType.type left join georegulation_part_feature as grPartFeature on grPartFeature.part_id = grPart.id left join georegulation_part_seasonal_period as grPartSeasonPeriod on grPartSeasonPeriod.part_id = grPart.id left join fixed_date_range as grPartDate on grPartDate.parent_id=grPart.id where gr.id = _grId and grPart.position=_partPosition group by gr.id, grPart.id, partInformation ); END; $$ LANGUAGE 'plpgsql';
